en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate Baroque pavilion set on a small terrace among blossoming trees and grass. The octagonal building has tall arched windows, a balustraded terrace, decorative cartouches, and a small domed lantern with an open belfry on top. A stone retaining wall with an inscription and a fountain-like niche is visible at the base. The scene is rural and slightly hilly, with terraced slopes in the background.
